program.ge_pattern: Columbia College General Education (CC-GE) Pattern or California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) Pattern
outcomes: Become successfully employed as a drive train technician.

notes: Catalog prints codes without a space (e.g. 'AT97'); these match closed-list codes AT 97, AT 105, AT 113, AT 120, AT 122, AT 132.

The description section repeats the lead-in 'Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:' with nothing under it; the outcome was taken from the Program Learning Outcomes section.
The career 'drive train technician' is taken from the program learning outcome text.
